```sql
    SELECT mb.component_id, mb.qty AS qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'TE1-120WAL55-0055'

      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cb.child_component_id, bom.qty * cb.qty
    FROM bom
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = bom.component_id AND c.is_assembly = true
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = bom.component_id

      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bom.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM bom
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = bom.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'TAB-496-BLK-02765'
  AND c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
    SELECT mb.component_id, c.is_assembly
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN company_model m ON m.model_id = mb.model_id
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = mb.component_id

      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)

)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE model_components AS (
    -- Direct components of the model
    SELECT
        mb.component_id,
        CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'TE1-160WAL85-0182'
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    -- Expand assemblies recursively
    SELECT
        cb.child_component_id,
        mc.qty * CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE)
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = mc.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = mc.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = TRUE
      AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(mc.qty * c.unit_cost), 2) AS total_parts_cost
FROM model_components mc
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = mc.component_id
WHERE c.is_assembly = FALSE;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE target AS (
    SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'CON-150-WAL-01063'
),
ancestors AS (
    SELECT cb.parent_component_id AS component_id
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN target t ON cb.child_component_id = t.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
    UNION
    SELECT cb.parent_component_id
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN ancestors a ON cb.child_component_id = a.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
),
all_components AS (
    SELECT component_id FROM target
    UNION
    SELECT component_id FROM ancestors
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mb.model_id) AS model_count
FROM model_bom mb
JOIN all_components ac ON mb.component_id = ac.component_id
WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
  AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to);
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
bundle_models AS (
    SELECT sm.model_id, bi.qty AS bundle_qty, sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = b.sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku item ON item.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = item.sku_id
    WHERE b.sku_code = 'BDL-US-0160'
),
model_parts AS (
    SELECT mb.model_id, mb.component_id, mb.qty::DOUBLE AS qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT mp.model_id, cb.child_component_id, mp.qty * cb.qty
    FROM model_parts mp
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = mp.component_id AND c.is_assembly = TRUE
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = mp.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bm.bundle_qty * bm.model_qty * mp.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM bundle_models bm
JOIN model_parts mp ON mp.model_id = bm.model_id
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = mp.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'FOO-834-BLK-01870'
  AND c.is_assembly = FALSE;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- 1. Resolve bundle -> item SKUs -> models, with quantities
bundle_models AS (
    SELECT
        bi.bundle_sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        bi.qty * sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
    WHERE bi.bundle_sku_id = (SELECT sku_id FROM sales_sku WHERE sku_code = 'BDL-DE-0329')
),
-- 2. Expand model BOM recursively down to parts
model_expansion AS (
    SELECT
        bm.bundle_sku_id,
        mb.component_id,
        bm.model_qty * mb.qty AS qty
    FROM bundle_models bm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = bm.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        me.bundle_sku_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        me.qty * cb.qty
    FROM model_expansion me
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = me.component_id AND c.is_assembly = TRUE
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = me.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(me.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM model_expansion me
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = me.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'CON-328-BLK-00970'
  AND c.is_assembly = FALSE;
```

```sql
    -- Start with direct components of the model
    SELECT 
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty
    FROM company_model cm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id

      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively expand assembly components
    SELECT 
        cb.child_component_id,
        bt.qty * cb.qty
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN component c ON bt.component_id = c.component_id
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- 1. Explode each order line down to base parts, using BOM valid on the order date
explode AS (
    -- Seed: order lines -> model BOM components (or bundle -> item SKU -> model BOM)
    SELECT
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        o.order_date,
        mb.component_id,
        CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty_per_unit
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = l.store_id
    JOIN sales_sku sku ON sku.sku_id = l.sku_id
    -- non-bundle path: sku -> model -> model_bom
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = sku.sku_id AND sku.is_bundle = FALSE
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = sm.model_id
        AND mb.valid_from <= o.order_date
        AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR o.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.store_name = 'Walmart-UK-22'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'

    UNION ALL

    -- bundle path: bundle sku -> item sku -> model -> model_bom
    SELECT
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        o.order_date,
        mb.component_id,
        CAST(bi.qty AS DOUBLE) * CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty_per_unit
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = l.store_id
    JOIN sales_sku sku ON sku.sku_id = l.sku_id AND sku.is_bundle = TRUE
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = sku.sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku item ON item.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = item.sku_id
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = sm.model_id
        AND mb.valid_from <= o.order_date
        AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR o.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.store_name = 'Walmart-UK-22'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'

    UNION ALL

    -- recursive: assembly component -> child components
    SELECT
        e.order_id,
        e.line_no,
        e.line_qty,
        e.order_date,
        cb.child_component_id,
        e.qty_per_unit * CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE)
    FROM explode e
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = e.component_id AND c.is_assembly = TRUE
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = e.component_id
        AND cb.valid_from <= e.order_date
        AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT
    SUM(e.line_qty * e.qty_per_unit) AS total_units
FROM explode e
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = e.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'FOO-140-GRY-02859'
  AND c.is_assembly = FALSE;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Explode each order line down to leaf parts, using BOM valid on the order date
explode AS (
    -- Base: model BOM edges for each order line's SKU (non-bundle) or bundle item SKUs
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.order_date,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS bom_qty
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN store st ON st.store_id = o.store_id
    -- non-bundle path
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = s.sku_id AND s.is_bundle = false
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = sm.model_id
        AND mb.valid_from <= o.order_date
        AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR o.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.store_name = 'Wayfair-DE-11'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'

    UNION ALL

    -- bundle path: bundle -> item sku -> model -> model bom
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.order_date,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS bom_qty
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id AND s.is_bundle = true
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = sm.model_id
        AND mb.valid_from <= o.order_date
        AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR o.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    JOIN store st ON st.store_id = o.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.store_name = 'Wayfair-DE-11'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
-- Recursively expand assemblies into leaf parts
tree AS (
    SELECT
        e.order_id,
        e.order_date,
        e.line_qty,
        e.component_id,
        CAST(e.bom_qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty_per_unit
    FROM explode e

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        t.order_id,
        t.order_date,
        t.line_qty,
        cb.child_component_id,
        t.qty_per_unit * cb.qty
    FROM tree t
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = t.component_id AND c.is_assembly = true
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = t.component_id
        AND cb.valid_from <= t.order_date
        AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR t.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(t.line_qty * t.qty_per_unit), 0) AS total_units
FROM tree t
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = t.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'FAS-359-GRY-00889'
  AND c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE part_tree AS (
    -- Start from the target part and walk up through component BOMs to find all ancestors
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_id AS descendant_id,
        1.0 AS qty_per_descendant
    FROM component c
    WHERE c.component_code = 'FOO-834-BLK-01870'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id,
        pt.descendant_id,
        cb.qty * pt.qty_per_descendant
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN part_tree pt ON cb.child_component_id = pt.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Get all components (parts and assemblies) that contain the target part, with quantities
component_containing_part AS (
    SELECT 
        component_id,
        SUM(qty_per_descendant) AS part_qty_per_component
    FROM part_tree
    WHERE component_id != descendant_id  -- exclude the part itself
    GROUP BY component_id
),
-- Get all models that use these components (directly or via assemblies)
model_component_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS component_qty_per_model
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Calculate part quantity per model
model_part_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        mcq.model_id,
        SUM(mcq.component_qty_per_model * COALESCE(ccp.part_qty_per_component, 0)) AS part_qty_per_model
    FROM model_component_qty mcq
    LEFT JOIN component_containing_part ccp ON mcq.component_id = ccp.component_id
    WHERE ccp.component_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY mcq.model_id
),
-- Get item SKUs in the bundle
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS item_qty_in_bundle
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sales_sku b ON bi.bundle_sku_id = b.sku_id
    WHERE b.sku_code = 'BDL-US-0160'
),
-- Map item SKUs to models
item_models AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.item_qty_in_bundle,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),
-- Calculate total part quantity per bundle

    SELECT 
        SUM(im.item_qty_in_bundle * im.model_qty_per_sku * mpq.part_qty_per_model) AS total_part_qty

)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, get the model_id for the target model
target_model AS (
    SELECT model_id 
    FROM company_model 
    WHERE model_code = 'ER9-140WHT90-0769'
),

-- Find all SKUs that directly map to this model
direct_skus AS (
    SELECT sku_id, qty as model_qty
    FROM sku_model
    WHERE model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM target_model)
),

-- Find all bundle SKUs that contain item SKUs mapping to this model
-- Need to trace: bundle -> item_sku -> model
bundle_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id as sku_id,
        sm.qty * bi.qty as model_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE sm.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM target_model)
),

-- Combine all SKUs that map to the target model (directly or via bundle)
all_model_skus AS (
    SELECT sku_id, model_qty FROM direct_skus
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sku_id, model_qty FROM bundle_skus
),

-- Get all listings for these SKUs
model_listings AS (
    SELECT l.listing_id, ams.model_qty
    FROM listing l
    JOIN all_model_skus ams ON l.sku_id = ams.sku_id
),

-- Calculate total units sold in 2024
sales AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(ol.qty * ml.model_qty) as total_units
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN model_listings ml ON ol.listing_id = ml.listing_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
    AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
)

SELECT COALESCE(total_units, 0) as total_units_sold FROM sales
```

```sql
        ol.order_line_qty as sku_qty  -- qty of this SKU in the order line
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false

        ol.order_line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        bi.item_sku_id as leaf_sku_id,
        ol.order_line_qty * bi.qty as sku_qty  -- bundle qty * item qty per bundle
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id

        es.line_no,
        es.order_line_qty,
        es.order_date,
        es.leaf_sku_id,
        es.sku_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty as model_qty_per_sku
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.leaf_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

    SELECT
```
